author: Progressor II
title: Run Consensus v2.7 Aggregation for Phantom Sim Data
abstract: This script executes the 'aggregate' command from shared/consensus_v1_5/cli.py to compute the Equilibria Index with bootstrap confidence intervals for existing phantom simulation data. This will provide a summarized, high-level view of consensus dynamics per lineage and globally, crucial for understanding baseline behavior before integrating with transgenerational data or searching for novelty.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

# Add the consensus_v1_5 directory to the Python path
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_5')

# Import the main function from cli.py and run the aggregate subcommand
from cli import main as cli_main

print("Executing Consensus v2.7 Aggregation...")

# Simulate command-line arguments for the aggregate subcommand
# Using default B=5000, eta=0.10, mode='blend_vote_extended' as per aggregate_v2_7.py
cli_main(argv=['aggregate'])

print("\nConsensus v2.7 Aggregation execution initiated. Outputs will be in storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7/.")
